summary: The ansible.builtin.memory cache plugin is a non-persistent RAM cache, the default when no other cache plugin is set, with no options.
questions: What is Ansible's default fact cache?
Do cached facts survive between playbook runs by default?
What options does the memory cache plugin have?

answer_card.title: memory cache plugin (default)
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.memory` is a RAM-backed, **non-persistent** cache and the default if no other cache plugin is configured. It has no options, so facts are not kept between runs.
